finance.shipmentCosts.page.title: Shipment costs
finance.shipmentCosts.page.description: One row per cost actually incurred on a container: type, amount, currency and rate, date and counterparty. The landed cost is allocated from these rows over the container's purchase lines.
finance.shipmentCosts.list.searchPlaceho: Search by cost type, container or note
finance.shipmentCosts.actions.deleteConf: Deleting removes the cost from the landed-cost allocation immediately; the audit log keeps the record of it.
finance.shipmentCosts.form.saveFailed: Could not save the shipment cost
finance.shipmentCosts.form.loadFailed: Could not load the shipment cost
finance.shipmentCosts.form.loadShipments: Could not load the container list
finance.shipmentCosts.form.loadPartiesFa: Could not load the counterparty list
finance.shipmentCosts.form.field.shipmen: A cancelled container cannot carry costs; a container of another organization is rejected.
finance.shipmentCosts.form.field.costTyp: Values come from the shipment_cost_type dictionary and can be extended in the dictionary library.
finance.shipmentCosts.form.field.allocat: Amount allocates by the purchase line's net total, quantity by the quantity allocated to this container. When the chosen weights are all zero the other dimension is used automatically.
finance.shipmentCosts.form.field.amountH: Must be greater than 0, at most 4 decimal places.
finance.shipmentCosts.form.field.currenc: Three-letter ISO code, e.g. CNY, USD.
finance.shipmentCosts.form.field.exchang: Leave empty to use the rate table. A fee with no resolvable rate is flagged and excluded from the allocation — never converted at 1.
finance.landedCosts.page.title: Landed cost
finance.landedCosts.page.description: Purchase value plus the container's allocated fees. Both the per-line and the per-SKU view; a line with no resolvable rate is flagged and stays out of the CNY totals.
finance.landedCosts.loadFailed: Could not derive the landed cost
finance.landedCosts.empty: This container has no allocatable purchase lines or costs.
finance.landedCosts.alert.unconvertibleF: {count} fee(s) have no resolvable rate and were excluded from the allocation (never converted at 1).
finance.landedCosts.alert.missingRates: {count} purchase line(s) have no resolvable rate; their CNY columns stay empty.
finance.inventoryValue.page.title: Inventory value
finance.inventoryValue.page.description: What the stock on hand is worth: the unit cost is the SKU's latest received container landed cost, else the product's purchase price tier. A row nothing can price is listed as unpriced, never valued at 0.
finance.inventoryValue.loadFailed: Could not derive the inventory value
finance.inventoryValue.alert.missingCost: Some stock has no usable unit cost and is listed as unpriced.
finance.inventoryValue.alert.unconvertib: {count} purchase price row(s) have no resolvable rate and were not converted to CNY.
finance.expenses.page.title: Period expenses
finance.expenses.page.description: Costs that belong to no container (advertising, platform fees, logistics, office): recorded against a period and taken straight into the profit-and-loss ledger.
finance.expenses.list.searchPlaceholder: Search by expense type or note
finance.expenses.actions.deleteConfirmBo: Deleting removes the expense from the profit-and-loss ledger immediately; the audit log keeps the record of it.
finance.expenses.form.loadChannelsFailed: Could not load the channel list
finance.expenses.form.loadPartiesFailed: Could not load the counterparty list
finance.expenses.form.field.expenseTypeH: Values come from the finance_expense_type dictionary and can be extended in the dictionary library.
finance.expenses.form.field.amountHelp: Must be greater than 0, at most 4 decimal places.
finance.expenses.form.field.exchangeRate: Leave empty to use the rate table. A fee with no resolvable rate is reported as unconvertible in the ledger — never converted at 1.
finance.expenses.form.field.periodHelp: Both ends inclusive; an end date before the start date is rejected.
finance.expenses.form.field.channelHelp: Attribute a platform or advertising bill to one marketplace channel; optional.
finance.payables.page.title: Payables
finance.payables.page.description: One row per placed purchase order, with the payment state derived by the purchasing module itself. Grouped by supplier and currency — amounts in different currencies are never added together.
finance.payables.alert.multiCurrency: Several currencies are present: amounts are listed per currency and never totalled across them.
finance.receivables.page.title: Receivables
finance.receivables.page.description: The three sources in one table: export collections, platform settlements and internal sales orders. Receipt is judged by the receipt date (not by a status word), and totals stay per currency.
finance.receivables.alert.multiCurrency: Several currencies are present: totals are listed per currency and never added across them.
finance.profitLoss.page.title: Profit and loss (ОПИУ)
finance.profitLoss.page.description: The ОПИУ rows in the RU page's order: the RU snapshot supplies revenue, platform fees, advertising and marginal profit, while the CN landed cost is one separate row in its own currency. Facts and forecasts are separate columns, never mixed.
finance.skuMargin.page.title: SKU margin
finance.skuMargin.page.description: The RU site-sales snapshot beside the CN landed cost, one column per currency. A mixed-caliber margin appears only when an FX rate exists, and rows outside the 0.2 п.п. / 20 ₽ tolerance are listed as reconciliation candidates.
finance.skuMargin.loadFailed: Could not assemble the SKU margin
finance.skuMargin.alert.discrepancies: {count} row(s) are outside tolerance and need a human
